summary: Re-review of the revised skill. All eight prior findings are fixed, and I verified the two substantive ones mechanically rather than taking them on report. The HIGH sponsored-CTA misattribution is genuinely resolved: 「記得點擊影片下面的連結,註冊一個帳戶。」and 「用我的連結,你們會得到最好的交易條件,我的客戶經理呢,也可以隨時協助你的所有問題。」are both present in data/transcripts/91Hpt_LyJSE.txt and absent from nzZ5oqmLjhM.txt, while 「點擊下面的連結開一個戶,註冊一個AXE賬戶,」and 「點擊下面的連結開戶,」are present in nzZ5oqmLjhM.txt and absent from 91Hpt_LyJSE.txt — each sponsored video now carries its own two CTA lines, and the added 客戶經理 affiliate line is stronger quarantine evidence than what was there before. The H-score gating is corrected to 50→總值 / 60→孵化 / 70→加速 in both files and, better than asked, evidence.md:87 now backs each rung with a verbatim (transcript) citation, all three confirmed in nzZ5oqmLjhM.txt and correctly attributed (with 90分 correctly left on 91Hpt_LyJSE). I re-extracted all 「」spans from both files: every one resolves verbatim against analysis/video_notes/ or data/transcripts/, and a per-line attribution check found no quote assigned to a video that does not contain it. The remaining six fixes all landed — 雙軌並行 is now a marked 推測 carrying 【推廣合作】 with the ASR damage stated and the 旁證 separated as 非同句, mirrored in the 對照表; the date range reads 2024-09 至 2026-02, matching the notes' 日期 fields; the MTF pointer is de-quoted; editorial labels are bold so corner brackets are corpus-only; the overnight rationale quotes the emotional reason and marks the exam framing 推測; the §4.2 TP/SL bullet points to lun-exit-management; and skill-relative ../../../ path forms are documented. Two low residuals remain, both cosmetic and neither affecting a user-facing rule.

findings.message: The overnight fix landed asymmetrically. SKILL.md:79 now quotes the emotional reason verbatim (「然後覺得很壓力。然後沮喪。開始情緒化交易。」) and marks the exam-account framing as （推測）, but the evidence.md bullet is still labelled 絕不過夜（考試帳戶保護習慣） with no 推測 marker — the same unmarked inference the SKILL.md edit removed. A reader consulting the evidence file alone still sees the interpretation presented as source fact.
findings.improvement: Relabel the bullet 絕不過夜（片中理由：情緒壓力；（推測）考試帳戶保護作用） so the reference file matches the marker discipline now applied in SKILL.md:79.

findings.message: Three SKILL.md lines carry a quote whose source video id is not on that line while a different video id is, which is the residue of the pattern that produced the original misattribution. Line 87: 「它沒有限定每日虧程是多少」is nzZ5oqmLjhM's but the only id on the line is 91Hpt_LyJSE, attached to the preceding quote. Line 72: the FTMO 兩階段 (transcript) quote is xmHaONnNrCw's, inferable only from the Step 4 header, while rE21_onS0uo appears later in the same line. Line 149: 「幾乎每兩個星期我都可以出境五位數美金」is 7j7_mhfda38's, while the only id on the line is MjPZizFnX-E. All three are attributed correctly in references/evidence.md and none crosses the sponsored/non-sponsored or lived/second-hand boundary, so no quarantine is breached — but the ids are not locally checkable.
findings.improvement: Append the owning video id inline at each of the three spots: （nzZ5oqmLjhM）after 「它沒有限定每日虧程是多少」on line 87, （xmHaONnNrCw）after the 兩階段 quote on line 72, and （7j7_mhfda38）after the 出境五位數 quote on line 149, so every quote in SKILL.md is verifiable from its own line.
